text_block_list.text: While walking around the Fan Appreciation Festival with Super Creek...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Kuh, a program change...? What on earth am I supposed to do...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Leave in the middle of Vivlos's live? ...Not a chance.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even so, if I stay until the very end, I won't get a good spot
for Cheval's ceremonial first pitch.
Seriously, what should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my.
Would you like a hand, if it's alright with you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, Super Creek-san?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes~. Saving a spot is something even I can do, so please let me help♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: No, but... the two of you are having such a good time together, I couldn't possibly intrude on your time—
choice_data_list: I'm totally fine with it too
I'm totally fine with it, too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
See?
Trainer is offering to help too, so why not give it a try and lean on them?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Since this is such a special stage for your younger sisters,
please make sure to watch them both from the best seats in the house♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Thank you for waiting...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I got the exact spot you asked for~♪
So, how was Vivlos-chan's live?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Vivlos was the absolute cutest!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
We got great footage, too...
Next is Cheval's turn, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Prior to the match,
Hall of Fame player Cheval Grand will throw out the ceremonial first pitch."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: You can do it, Cheval...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
“Here goes Cheval Grand!
A big windup... and she throws!”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ! Nice forkball!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Thanks to the two of you, I was able to watch my little sisters perform their best.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Once again, allow me to express my gratitude.
choice_data_list: You really love your little sister, huh.
You really love your little sister, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes. More than anything.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to watch over
the efforts of those girls as closely as possible.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"All so I can praise her later.
And so I can be an older sister worthy of her hard work."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now, now.
Now, now, now, now...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Verxina-chan truly is such a wonderful big sister~!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu... There, there♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
I-Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes. Veeeery much so!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
As an older sister,
your kindness in praising your little sister's hard work, too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And the strength to discipline yourself so you can be a role model for your little sisters.
Both are truly, wonderfully admirable~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You're usually the one praising everyone else,
so please let me give you lots of praise today.
...Fufu, there, there♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Um... Ah, I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Um, I wish I could give cute reactions like my younger sisters, but... it's quite difficult, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You're plenty cute already~âª
But if you're not used to it, we'll just have to praise you waaaay more.
...Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give lots of praise!
Yeah, let's shower them with praise!
I kind of get why it's embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You're plenty cute already~âª
But if you're not used to it, we'll just have to praise you waaaay more.
...Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give lots of praise!
Yeah, let's shower them with praise!
I kind of get why it's embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Let us in on that conversation too~!
And after that, I want you to praise me too~♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Vivlos! Cheval too!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my. Everyone's gathered together~. Well then,
shall we give them all a good pat on the head?

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
—There, there, Verxina-chan♪
—There, there, Big Sis♡
—S-Sis... there, there.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, thank you.
You were all such very good girls, too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well then, as a reward first,
shall we go eat something delicious~?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
What would you like to eat~?
Since I'm the big sister right now,
you can pick whatever you like, Verxina-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, that's true.
Um, what should we do...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
You must usually give way to everyone else, huh~?
Good boy, good boy♪
And so, Super Creek showered Verxina with praise to her heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are!
Big sis~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Wait, whoa?!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Cheval, Vivlos...
I am your big sister, aren't I...?
I'm not a baby, right...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Wh-What is it...? I'm scared...!
choice_data_list: Sorry, looks like I overdid it a bit...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Sorry, it just kinda happened~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, you too, Trainer~?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll shower both of you
with lots and lots of praise♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: P-Please go easy on me...?

However, Super Creek showed no mercy whatsoever...
In the end, both she and Verxina wound up
blushing furiously together.
